verses.en: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies;
verses.pt: Ora, estando o rei Davi em sua casa e tendo-lhe dado o Senhor descanso de todos os seus inimigos em redor,
verses.en_web: When the king lived in his house, and Yahweh had given him rest from all his enemies all around,
verses.en_bbe: Now when the king was living in his house, and the Lord had given him rest from war on every side;

verses.en: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.
verses.pt: disse ele ao profeta Natã: Eis que eu moro numa casa de cedro, enquanto que a arca de Deus dentro de uma tenda.
verses.en_web: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”
verses.en_bbe: The king said to Nathan the prophet, See now, I am living in a house of cedar, but the ark of God is housed inside the curtains of a tent.

verses.en: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the LORD is with thee.
verses.pt: Respondeu Natã ao rei: Vai e faze tudo quanto está no teu coração, porque o Senhor é contigo.
verses.en_web: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart; for Yahweh is with you.”
verses.en_bbe: And Nathan said to the king, Go and do whatever is in your heart; for the Lord is with you.

verses.en: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan, saying,
verses.pt: Mas naquela mesma noite a palavra do Senhor veio a Natã, dizendo:
verses.en_web: That same night, Yahweh’s word came to Nathan, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Now that night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,

verses.en: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?
verses.pt: Vai, e dize a meu servo Davi: Assim diz o Senhor: Edificar-me-ás tu uma casa para eu nela habitar?
verses.en_web: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?
verses.en_bbe: Go and say to my servant David, The Lord says, Are you to be the builder of a house, a living-place for me?

verses.en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.
verses.pt: Porque em casa nenhuma habitei, desde o dia em que fiz subir do Egito os filhos de Israel até o dia de hoje, mas tenho andado em tenda e em tabernáculo.
verses.en_web: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.
verses.en_bbe: For from the day when I took the children of Israel up out of Egypt till this day, I have had no house, but have gone from place to place in a tent.

verses.en: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?
verses.pt: E em todo lugar em que tenho andado com todos os filhos de Israel, falei porventura, alguma palavra a qualquer das suas tribos a que mandei apascentar o meu povo de Israel, dizendo: por que não me edificais uma casa de cedro?
verses.en_web: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
verses.en_bbe: In all the places where I went with all the children of Israel, did I ever say to any of the judges of Israel, to whom I gave the care of my people Israel, Why have you not made me a house of cedar?

verses.en: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:
verses.pt: Agora, pois, assim dirás ao meu servo Davi: Assim diz o Senhor dos exércitos: Eu te tomei da malhada, de detrás das ovelhas, para que fosses príncipe sobre o meu povo, sobre Israel;
verses.en_web: Now therefore tell my servant David this, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Then say these words to my servant David, The Lord of armies says, I took you from the fields, from keeping the sheep, so that you might be a ruler over my people, over my people Israel:

verses.en: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.
verses.pt: e fui contigo, por onde quer que foste, e destruí a todos os teus inimigos diante de ti; e te farei um grande nome, como o nome dos grandes que há na terra.
verses.en_web: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And I have been with you wherever you went, cutting off before you all those who were against you; and I will make your name great, like the name of the greatest ones of the earth.

verses.en: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,
verses.pt: Também designarei lugar para o meu povo, para Israel, e o plantarei ali, para que ele habite no seu lugar, e não mais seja perturbado, e nunca mais os filhos da iniqüidade o aflijam, como dantes,
verses.en_web: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,
verses.en_bbe: And I will make a resting-place for my people Israel, planting them there, so that they may be living in the place which is theirs, and never again be moved; and never again will they be troubled by evil men as they were at the first,

verses.en: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house.
verses.pt: e como desde o dia em que ordenei que houvesse juízes sobre o meu povo Israel. A ti, porém, darei descanso de todos os teus inimigos. Também o Senhor te declara que ele te fará casa.
verses.en_web: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover Yahweh tells you that Yahweh will make you a house.
verses.en_bbe: From the time when I put judges over my people Israel; and I will give you peace from all who are against you. And the Lord says to you that he will make you the head of a line of kings.

verses.en: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.pt: Quando teus dias forem completos, e vieres a dormir com teus pais, então farei levantar depois de ti um dentre a tua descendência, que sair das tuas entranhas, e estabelecerei o seu reino.
verses.en_web: When your days are fulfilled, and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: And when the time comes for you to go to rest with your fathers, I will put in your place your seed after you, the offspring of your body, and I will make his kingdom strong.

verses.en: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.
verses.pt: Este edificará uma casa ao meu nome, e eu estabelecerei para sempre o trono do seu reino.
verses.en_web: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
verses.en_bbe: He will be the builder of a house for my name, and I will make the seat of his authority certain for ever.

verses.en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:
verses.pt: Eu lhe serei pai, e ele me será filho. E, se vier a transgredir, castigá-lo-ei com vara de homens, e com açoites de filhos de homens;
verses.en_web: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men;
verses.en_bbe: I will be to him a father and he will be to me a son: if he does wrong, I will give him punishment with the rod of men and with the blows of the children of men;

verses.en: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.
verses.pt: mas não retirarei dele a minha benignidade como a retirei de Saul, a quem tirei de diante de ti.
verses.en_web: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.
verses.en_bbe: But my mercy will not be taken away from him, as I took it from him who was before you.

verses.en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
verses.pt: A tua casa, porém, e o teu reino serão firmados para sempre diante de ti; teu trono será estabelecido para sempre.
verses.en_web: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”
verses.en_bbe: And your family and your kingdom will keep their place before me for ever: the seat of your authority will never be overturned.

verses.en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.pt: Conforme todas estas palavras, e conforme toda esta visão, assim falou Natã a Davi.
verses.en_web: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.
verses.en_bbe: So Nathan gave David an account of all these words and this vision.

verses.en: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.pt: Então entrou o rei Davi, e sentou-se perante o Senhor, e disse: Quem sou eu, Senhor Jeová, e que é a minha casa, para me teres trazido até aqui?
verses.en_web: Then David the king went in, and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Lord Yahweh, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
verses.en_bbe: Then David the king went in and took his seat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my family, that you have been my guide till now?

verses.en: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant’s house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord GOD?
verses.pt: E isso ainda foi pouco aos teus olhos, Senhor Jeová, senão que também falaste da casa do teu servo para tempos distantes; e me tens mostrado gerações futuras, ó Senhor Jeová?
verses.en_web: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord Yahweh; but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord Yahweh!
verses.en_bbe: And this was only a small thing to you, O Lord God; but your words have even been about the far-off future of your servant's family, O Lord God!

verses.en: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD, knowest thy servant.
verses.pt: Que mais te poderá dizer Davi. pois tu conheces bem o teu servo, ó Senhor Jeová.
verses.en_web: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: What more may David say to you? for you have knowledge of your servant, O Lord God.

verses.en: For thy word’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.
verses.pt: Por causa da tua palavra, e segundo o teu coração, fizeste toda esta grandeza, revelando-a ao teu servo.
verses.en_web: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.
verses.en_bbe: Because of your word and from your heart, you have done all this great work, and let your servant see it.

verses.en: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.pt: Portanto és grandioso, ó Senhor Jeová, porque ninguém há semelhante a ti, e não há Deus senão tu só, segundo tudo o que temos ouvido com os nossos ouvidos.
verses.en_web: Therefore you are great, Yahweh God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.en_bbe: Truly you are great, O Lord God: there is no one like you and no other God but you, as is clear from everything which has come to our ears.

verses.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?
verses.pt: Que outra nação na terra é semelhante a teu povo Israel, a quem tu, ó Deus, foste resgatar para te ser povo, para te fazeres um nome, e para fazeres a seu favor estas grandes e terríveis coisas para a tua terra, diante do teu povo, que tu resgataste para ti do Egito, desterrando nações e seus deuses?
verses.en_web: What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?
verses.en_bbe: And what other nation in the earth, like your people Israel, did a god go out to take for himself, to be his people, and to make a name for himself, and to do great and strange things for them, driving out a nation and its gods from before his people?

verses.en: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD, art become their God.
verses.pt: Assim estabeleceste o teu povo Israel por teu povo para sempre, e tu, Senhor, te fizeste o seu Deus.
verses.en_web: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.
verses.en_bbe: But you took and made strong for yourself your people Israel, to be your people for ever; and you, Lord, became their God.

verses.en: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, o Senhor Jeová, confirma para sempre a palavra que falaste acerca do teu servo e acerca da sua casa, e faze como tens falado,
verses.en_web: Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.
verses.en_bbe: And now, O Lord God, may the word which you have said about your servant and about his family, be made certain for ever, and may you do as you have said!

verses.en: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.
verses.pt: para que seja engrandecido o teu nome para sempre, e se diga: O Senhor dos exércitos é Deus sobre Israel; e a casa do teu servo será estabelecida diante de ti.
verses.en_web: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’
verses.en_bbe: And let your name be made great for ever, and let men say, The Lord of armies is God over Israel: and let the family of David your servant be made strong before you!

verses.en: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.
verses.pt: Pois tu, Senhor dos exércitos, Deus de Israel, fizeste uma revelação ao teu servo, dizendo: Edificar-te-ei uma casa. Por isso o teu servo se animou a fazer-te esta oração.
verses.en_web: For you, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.
verses.en_bbe: For you, O Lord of armies, the God of Israel, have clearly said to your servant, I will make you the head of a family of kings: and so it has come into your servant's heart to make this prayer to you.

verses.en: And now, O Lord GOD, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.pt: Agora, pois, Senhor Jeová, tu és Deus, e as tuas palavras são verdade, e tens prometido a teu servo este bem.
verses.en_web: “Now, O Lord Yahweh, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.
verses.en_bbe: And now, O Lord God, you are God and your words are true and you have said you will give your servant this good thing;

verses.en: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.
verses.pt: Sê, pois, agora servido de abençoar a casa do teu servo, para que subsista para sempre diante de ti; pois tu, ó Senhor Jeová, o disseste; e com a tua bênção a casa do teu servo será, abençoada para sempre.
verses.en_web: Now therefore let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord Yahweh, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”
verses.en_bbe: So may it be your pleasure to give your blessing to the family of your servant, so that it may go on for ever before you: (for you, O Lord God, have said it,) and may your blessing be on your servant's family line for ever!
